senses.definition: (ditransitive) To give (someone or something) to (someone or something else) as food.
examples: Don't feed him too much; he's still a baby.
Feed the fish to the dolphins.

senses.definition: (transitive) To give to a machine to be processed.
examples: Feed the paper gently into the document shredder.

senses.definition: (transitive) To supply (a machine) with something to be processed.
examples: We got interesting results after feeding the computer with the new data.

senses.definition: (transitive, figurative) To satisfy, gratify, or minister to (a sense, taste, desire, etc.).

senses.definition: (Internet) online content presented sequentially:

subsenses.definition: (syndication or aggregation): antichronological sequence of posts or articles from a single source, especially as consumable on a platform other as originally published.
examples: I've subscribed to the feeds of my favourite blogs, so I can find out when new posts are added without having to visit those sites.

subsenses.definition: (social media, often after a possessive determiner) content intended for consumption by scrolling or swiping, especially as a home page and from multiple publishers followed or algorithmically curated
